task.ques: Look up the British pronunciation of the word "euphoria" and find an example sentence using that word on the Cambridge Dictionary.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: Cambridge Dictionary gives the British (UK) pronunciation of “euphoria” as /juːˈfɔː.ri.ə/. Example sentence: “They were in a state of euphoria for days after they won the prize.”
Source: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/euphoria (accessed 27 October 2026).
Evidence: final.png shows the word, UK pronunciation and example together.
